acceptanceCriteria: A fixture with 5,000 symbol anchors builds within a constant Git operation count per phase (measured as in git_budget_test.go).
CEM, legacy-case and Playwright discovery reads batch their paths; a 5,000-path fixture does not exceed the Git budget.
body: Found by the V1-1984 lane (PR #1253, batch #1257). V1-1984 batched freshness, inventory and build input reads (DCP-V1-155..159), but internal/doccorpus/symbol_anchor.go still does one tree lookup per cited anchor, and cem.go plus the legacy-case and Playwright discovery paths still open a default gitrun budget per path. A corpus with many symbol anchors or discovery inputs can still hit git-budget-exceeded near 1,024 operations. Expected: Git operations per phase stay constant in the number of anchors/paths, as for V1-1984's inputs.
title: Docs corpus: symbol anchors and CEM/legacy/Playwright discovery still spend one Git operation per path after V1-1984
